assertions.name: B1_sl_exponent_is_twice_colour_factor_all_N
assertions.source: sl exponents = 2c_R, gl = 2c_R + 1/N, ratio -(N + 1)/(N - 1), =2 iff N in [3]

assertions.name: B2_singlet_transparency_forces_q_minus_1_over_N
assertions.source: gl_N monodromy of V around Lambda^N_q is q^2 (explicit N=2,3; contents for all N); trivial singlet forces c = [q**(-1/N), (-1/q)**(1/N)]

assertions.name: B4_both_arms_gl_ratio_1_sl_ratio_2
assertions.source: gl_3 ratio 1.0, sl_3 ratio 2.0, signs preserved

description: The factor 2 in the level-3 colour-factor test (level_three_colour_channel_probe A4) is the u_1 part of gl_N = sl_N + u_1. The Hecke generator is the gl_N braiding; its exponents are 2c_R + 1/N where c_R = (C_2(R) - 2C_F)/2 is the QCD one-gluon colour factor. The SU(N) braiding q^(-1/N) sigma has exponents exactly 2c_R, giving ratio (N+1)/(N-1) = 2 at N = 3 with correct signs. The factor q^(-1/N) is forced, not fitted: in gl_N the monodromy of V around the q-antisymmetric line Lambda^N_q is q^2 (explicit Jimbo matrices N=2,3; Young contents all N), and requiring the colour singlet to braid trivially gives c^(2N) q^2 = 1, c = q^(-1/N). This is also the e = e_max/3 value already recorded by the level-3 probe A6. It does not repair the nuclear ratio (sl_2 gives 3, not 33.7).
caveats: Applying the SU(N) frame to colour observables is a modelling ruling (bean qou-sl3f), not established here. Rescaling sigma multiplies an unnormalised Markov trace of a word by c^writhe and shifts the Markov parameter z -> c z; it must not be applied to already-ruled gl/convention-D observables without an owner decision.
The identification of the two-strand Wedderburn blocks with 3bar and 6 is inherited from level_three_colour_channel_probe and is not constructed here.
q0AnchorReason: q0 enters only the B4/B5 numerical arms via q_parameter.q_at, which resolves to the proton pin (standing compute default, 2026-08-07 directive). B1-B3 are symbolic or exact-rational and q0-free.
